articles.title: DataSpace: Benchmarking Data Agents for Verifiable Analytics over Heterogeneous Workspaces

articles.summary: 现代希腊语在NVIDIA Nemotron检索模型及主流多语言基准中缺失，制约法律、能源、金融、医疗领域的RAG应用。提出端到端适配方案：挖掘语料、调整检索、结合领域知识约束生成，使Nemotron检索栈支持现代希腊语并提升专业领域效果。

articles.title: Beyond Simply Environment Scaling: Designing Effective Environment Distributions for Multimodal Agent Learning

articles.summary: 研究发现单纯增加多模态环境数量并不总能提升智能体学习效果。通过系列实验分析当前环境分布的局限，提出设计有效环境分布的策略而非盲目扩展规模，从而改善多模态智能体的训练效率与泛化能力。

articles.title: MatrAIx: Simulating the World with 8.3 Billion Persona Agents

articles.title: StreamArena: Toward Continuous, Interactive, and Long-Horizon Agentic Streaming Video Understanding

articles.title: MASS: Multiplayer World Models with Authoritative Shared State
